main.title: About me

p1.rest: with experience working in design studios and product teams. I work on mobile and web products for mass audiences, e-commerce, B2C and B2B services.

main.p2: I participate in the full product development cycle — from pre-project analytics, hypothesis generation, and user journey mapping — to UI design, design reviews, and implementation support. I'm comfortable working both on products built from scratch and on supporting existing solutions.
main.p3: I study psychology to better understand users and apply this knowledge in UX research.
